data.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research

content.basic: Built by DeepMind alumni, British AI lab Inherent released Faraday, an AI agent whose ability to replicate scientific papers could be a stepping stone for innovation.

data.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill

content.basic: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill that the company previously opposed.
